prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 36 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1297; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Treatment summary: The patient presented after a sideswipe collision during a lane change and reported neck and back strain. The reported mechanism is plausible for a collision of this type. Care has included 36 visits, with near-daily attendance for much of the period, a volume well above what is typically expected for this injury. Additional body regions were reported several weeks after the collision and have since been added to the treatment plan. Imaging of the cervical and lumbar spine is unremarkable, and physical examination findings fall within normal limits. Nearly all reported symptoms rest on the patient's own description of pain, as no objective findings have been identified. No prior injury to the same areas is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed show no repeated charges for the same services. Plan: continue home exercise program, reassess function in four weeks, and consider tapering visit frequency as symptoms allow.
